release_notes:
v1.0.25+32 - Video Masterclasses, Instant Material Access & Strict Account-Scoped Security
- Instant Digital Material Delivery: 1 KES Music Theory PDF and store downloads unlock immediately upon M-Pesa confirmation with automatic launch and a prominent 'OPEN NOW' action
- Clean Unoccupied Phone Input: M-Pesa number prompt starts completely empty with a subtle italic placeholder hint (e.g. 0712345678)
- Strict Account-Scoped Product Locking: Logging out immediately purges all unlocked items and active passes from local storage; logging in with another account never leaks previously purchased items
- Central Mind Video Tutorials: Video masterclasses query live Supabase tables with zero static mock fallbacks
- Transient Guest Video Passes: Guests can browse video tutorials directly from the Landing Screen and Guest Catalog with hourly passes (1 hr, 3 hr, 24 hr) and automatic video playback upon payment
- Safaricom Daraja STK Processing: Fixed ResultCode 4999 non-terminal polling so the app waits reliably for the user to enter their PIN without prematurely timing out
